diagnosis: The endpoint iterates through the application's Prometheus CollectorRegistry and extracts all samples matching tenant_id from the URL path. It does not verify that current_user belongs to tenant_id, allowing any authenticated user to inspect request counts, error rates, and p99 latency figures of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /metrics/sla/tnt_megacorp_fintech HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.saas.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_customer_token>
